provisional: The project's tests cannot run in the engine as it is: they start supabase/postgres containers through Docker (TestTenantDb.Backend.Docker), or need several running supabase/postgres servers on extra ports (USE_EXTERNAL_TENANT_DB), and the database must be Supabase's own Postgres build (roles supabase_admin, anon, authenticated, service_role; schemas auth and extensions; logical WAL). The engine runs one stock Postgres on 5432 and no Docker inside the workspace. See docs/data/2026-11-12_cases_supabase_realtime/.
